name: Vertex Classification for Piecewise Linear Fields
aliases: Gerstner and Pajarola's Vertex Classification for Piecewise Linear Fields
definition: A method to classify mesh vertices in piecewise linear scalar fields (C0-continuous) as regular, maximum, minimum, or saddle points based on the connectivity of an edge graph derived from a surrounding polyhedron.
summary: Vertex Classification for Piecewise Linear Fields classifies mesh vertices as regular, maximum, minimum, or saddle points by analyzing the topological connectivity of an edge graph derived from the local neighborhood, distinguishing itself from differentiable methods by operating on discrete, non-differentiable data.
